versos.grego: Ἀδελφοί, ἡ μὲν εὐδοκία τῆς ἐμῆς καρδίας καὶ ἡ δέησις πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν εἰς σωτηρίαν.

controles.web: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
controles.kjv: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
controles.livre: Irmãos, o bom desejo do meu coração, e a oração que faço a Deus por eles,  é que sejam salvos.

versos.grego: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτοῖς ὅτι ζῆλον Θεοῦ ἔχουσιν, ἀλλ’ οὐ κατ’ ἐπίγνωσιν·

controles.web: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
controles.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
controles.livre: Pois lhes dou testemunho de que eles têm zelo por Deus, mas não com entendimento.

versos.grego: ἀγνοοῦντες γὰρ τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην, καὶ τὴν ἰδίαν ζητοῦντες στῆσαι, τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐχ ὑπετάγησαν.

controles.web: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
controles.kjv: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
controles.livre: Pois, como ignoraram a justiça de Deus, e procuraram estabelecer a sua própria justiça, eles não se sujeitaram à justiça de Deus.

versos.grego: τέλος γὰρ νόμου Χριστὸς εἰς δικαιοσύνην παντὶ τῷ πιστεύοντι.

controles.web: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
controles.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
controles.livre: Porque o fim da Lei é Cristo, para justiça de todo aquele que crê.

versos.grego: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ γράφει ὅτι τὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ νόμου ὁ ποιήσας ἄνθρωπος ζήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ.

controles.web: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
controles.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
controles.livre: Pois Moisés descreve a justiça que é pela Lei: “A pessoa que praticar estas coisas viverá por elas”.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ἐκ πίστεως δικαιοσύνη οὕτως λέγει Μὴ εἴπῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου Τίς ἀναβήσεται εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν; τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χριστὸν καταγαγεῖν·

controles.web: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
controles.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
controles.livre: Mas a justiça que é pela fé assim diz: “Não digas em teu coração: ‘Quem subirá ao céu?’  (Isto é, trazer Cristo abaixo),

versos.grego: ἤ Τίς καταβήσεται εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον; τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χριστὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναγαγεῖν.

controles.web: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
controles.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
controles.livre: ou: ‘Quem descerá ao abismo?’”  (Isto é, trazer Cristo dentre os mortos).

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τί λέγει; Ἐγγύς σου τὸ ῥῆμά ἐστιν, ἐν τῷ στόματί σου καὶ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου· τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τῆς πίστεως ὃ κηρύσσομεν.

controles.web: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart”; that is, the word of faith, which we preach:
controles.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
controles.livre: Porém, o que diz? “A palavra está perto de ti, na tua boca, e no teu coração”.  Esta é a palavra da fé, que pregamos.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃς ἐν τῷ στόματί σου Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, καὶ πιστεύσῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς αὐτὸν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, σωθήσῃ·

controles.web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
controles.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
controles.livre: Pois, se com a tua boca declarares que Jesus é Senhor, e em teu coração creres que Deus o ressuscitou dos mortos, serás salvo.

versos.grego: καρδίᾳ γὰρ πιστεύεται εἰς δικαιοσύνην, στόματι δὲ ὁμολογεῖται εἰς σωτηρίαν.

controles.web: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
controles.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
controles.livre: Pois com o coração se crê para a justiça,  e com a boca se confessa para a salvação.

versos.grego: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται.

controles.web: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
controles.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
controles.livre: Porque a Escritura diz: “Todo aquele que nele crê não será envergonhado.”

versos.grego: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν διαστολὴ Ἰουδαίου τε καὶ Ἕλληνος· ὁ γὰρ αὐτὸς Κύριος πάντων, πλουτῶν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους αὐτόν·

controles.web: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
controles.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
controles.livre: Pois não há diferença entre judeu e grego, porque um mesmo é o Senhor de todos, rico para todos os que o invocam.

versos.grego: Πᾶς γὰρ ὃς ἂν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου σωθήσεται.

controles.web: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
controles.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
controles.livre: Pois: “Todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.”

versos.grego: πῶς οὖν ἐπικαλέσωνται εἰς ὃν οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν; πῶς δὲ πιστεύσωσιν οὗ οὐκ ἤκουσαν; πῶς δὲ ἀκούσωσιν χωρὶς κηρύσσοντος;

controles.web: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
controles.kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
controles.livre: Mas como invocarão em quem não creram? E como crerão naquele de quem não ouviram? E como ouvirão sem haver quem pregue?

versos.grego: πῶς δὲ κηρύξωσιν ἐὰν μὴ ἀποσταλῶσιν; καθάπερ γέγραπται Ὡς ὡραῖοι οἱ πόδες τῶν εὐαγγελιζομένων ἀγαθά.

controles.web: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written:  “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
controles.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
controles.livre: E como pregarão se não forem enviados? Como está escrito: “Como são agradáveis  os pés dos que  anunciam as boas novas!”

versos.grego: Ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντες ὑπήκουσαν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ. Ἡσαΐας γὰρ λέγει Κύριε, τίς ἐπίστευσεν τῇ ἀκοῇ ἡμῶν;

controles.web: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
controles.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
controles.livre: Mas nem todos obedeceram ao Evangelho, pois Isaías diz: “Senhor, quem creu na nossa pregação?”

versos.grego: ἄρα ἡ πίστις ἐξ ἀκοῆς, ἡ δὲ ἀκοὴ διὰ ῥήματος Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
controles.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
controles.livre: Portanto, a fé vem pelo ouvir, e o ouvir pela palavra de Cristo.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ λέγω, μὴ οὐκ ἤκουσαν; μενοῦνγε Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος αὐτῶν, καὶ εἰς τὰ πέρατα τῆς οἰκουμένης τὰ ῥήματα αὐτῶν.

controles.web: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly,  “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
controles.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
controles.livre: Mas pergunto: por acaso não ouviram? Sim, certamente. Pois: “Sua voz saiu por toda a terra, e suas palavras até os confins do mundo.”

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ λέγω, μὴ Ἰσραὴλ οὐκ ἔγνω; πρῶτος Μωϋσῆς λέγει Ἐγὼ παραζηλώσω ὑμᾶς ἐπ’ οὐκ ἔθνει, ἐπ’ ἔθνει ἀσυνέτῳ παροργιῶ ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says,  “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.”
controles.kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
controles.livre: Mas pergunto: por acaso Israel não entendeu? Primeiramente Moisés disse: “Eu vos provocarei ciúmes com os que não são do povo; com uma nação insensata vos provocarei à ira.”

versos.grego: Ἡσαΐας δὲ ἀποτολμᾷ καὶ λέγει Εὑρέθην τοῖς ἐμὲ μὴ ζητοῦσιν, ἐμφανὴς ἐγενόμην τοῖς ἐμὲ μὴ ἐπερωτῶσιν.

controles.web: Isaiah is very bold, and says,  “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
controles.kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
controles.livre: E Isaías ousou dizer: “Fui achado pelos que não me buscavam; fui revelado aos que por mim não perguntavam.”

versos.grego: πρὸς δὲ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ λέγει Ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐξεπέτασα τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς λαὸν ἀπειθοῦντα καὶ ἀντιλέγοντα.

controles.web: But as to Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
controles.kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
controles.livre: Mas sobre Israel diz: “Todo o dia estendi as minhas mãos a um povo rebelde e hostil.”
